Two comments

The Bellydancer

An epic tune from Session A9. They’re clearly showing off.

It’s not as much as it seems, there is a lot of repetition, but the structure is something like ABCBCADC but not exactly so it’s still a test of memory.

I think it’s exposed a bug in abcjs while rendering the midi -- bar 12 (first of line 5) is played with B naturals when it loops to repeat. So if you’re listening to the audio, beware.

↳ Posted by spraff on January 13th, 2025.

The Bellydancer, X:2

This is Gordon Duncan’s setting from Thunderstruck that I posted in a discussion about four years ago:
https://thesession.org/discussions/45986#comment919138

To be honest, I’m not really sure this is a “session” tune!

↳ Posted by DonaldK on January 13th, 2025.
